_comment: Reviewed exemptions for scripts/quality/check-test-task-coverage.py. Each entry means: a human
decided this custom Gradle Test task is deliberately not reachable from a plain CI workflow scan
(e.g. genuinely nightly-only, or invoked only through a generated-app copy), and here is why.
The key is a fingerprint of the task's qualified name + declaring directory, so moving or renaming
the task invalidates the exemption and it resurfaces for re-review -- which is the point.
Empty today: as of 2026-07-27 both custom Test tasks in the repo (:generator:behaviorTest,
NPDevRuntimeHost's integrationTest) are judged directly reachable by the gate. Add an entry here
only when the gate actually flags a violation for a task that is genuinely covered by a path the
gate cannot see -- do not pre-clear anything speculatively.
